cards.mood: The piece opens with a somber, narrative-driven atmosphere that feels like an ancient tale being recounted.
cards.palette: An acoustic guitar with a steady, finger-picked arpeggio pattern serves as the harmonic backbone throughout the entire track, providing continuity and rhythmic stability.

lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Beneath the arch of ancient stone,
Where shadows stretch and secrets grow,
He stood alone upon the throne,
Where rivers of the past still flow.
[Pre-Chorus]
The whispers of the elders rise,
Underneath the turning of the skies.
[Chorus]
One choice to mend the broken land,
One spark to light the fading sun,
With every heart and every hand,
The journey has only just begun.
[Verse]
She gathered truth within her palms,
A tapestry of gold and grey,
Through winter's frost and summer's calms,
She chased the ghosts of yesterday.
[Pre-Chorus]
The banners fly in steady line,
Where the old and new entwine.
[Chorus]
One choice to mend the broken land,
One spark to light the fading sun,
With every heart and every hand,
The journey has only just begun.
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
The heavy weight of crown and bone,
A fate that must be faced alone.
[Chorus]
One choice to mend the broken land,
One spark to light the fading sun,
With every heart and every hand,
The journey has only just begun.
[Outro]
